scope: Original TC6 item aspect tooltip, adapted to the native Minecraft 1.21.1 tooltip component API.

behavior.screen: Inventory/container screens, including player/creative inventory and chests
behavior.visible_when: shiftDown != showTags, with the pointer not captured
behavior.aspect_values: Same RecipeAspects calculation used for gameplay, based on synced recipes and item tags
behavior.sort: Descending amount; stable input order for ties
behavior.row_location: Inside the ordinary item tooltip, after its existing components
behavior.count: White at the lower-right of each icon, with a black outline

modern_adaptations: A real tooltip component replaces the original whitespace padding and PostBackground drawing.
Long rows wrap at the available tooltip/screen width instead of extending off-screen.
Small numbers use the existing native-font pixel alignment policy, preventing fractional physical-pixel glyphs at low GUI scales.
verification: AspectTooltipTest covers visibility/config inversion, stable ordering, 16/18-pixel geometry, all-37-aspect wrapping, empty layout, and immutable tooltip snapshots. These unit checks do not exercise OpenGL; consult the release runtime report for client-rendering evidence.
